name: Moat
author: the2dl
description: Runtime security monitor for Omarchy: surfaces Tetragon-backed credential, package-manager, persistence and egress alerts in the bar, with kill / quarantine / ack / ignore actions and secret-rotation guidance.

barWidget.description: Shield glyph showing unacknowledged runtime security alerts. Click to open the alert panel.

schema.label: Minimum notify severity
schema.description: Alerts below this severity never raise a desktop notification. They still appear in the panel.

schema.label: Notification cooldown (minutes)
schema.description: At most one notification per rule per this many minutes. Further alerts of that rule are counted and land as one "N more from ..." notification when the window ends; they are all in the panel either way. Critical alerts seen for the first time on this machine ignore the cooldown.

schema.label: Status poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often moatctl status is polled for mode, tetragon state, policies and feed age.

schema.label: Show count badge
schema.description: Draw the number of unacknowledged high and critical alerts on the shield.

schema.label: Show suppressed alerts
schema.description: Include alerts a learned or user allowlist entry already covers in the panel timeline, greyed out. They never notify and never count toward the badge either way.

schema.label: Weekly digest notification
schema.description: One notification a week summarising incidents, installs watched and baseline proposals waiting for review. The only scheduled notification moat sends; moatd sends it, this is the off switch.
